slug: 震惊五星灵帝被逼着撩妹
lines: 灵黔峰，主峰大殿。
杨卤盘坐在蒲团上，双目微闭，周身五颗金色星核缓缓旋转，散发着淡淡的帝威。
三百年了。
自从妻子徐云离世，他就在这座山峰上闭门不出，连曾经并肩作战的老友都不再见。女儿嫁人之后，这偌大的灵黔峰，就只剩他一个孤寡老头守着。
说是老头也不对，修星者的寿命本就漫长，他这张脸看着也就八九十出头的样子，但心已经老透了。
一声清脆的喊声从殿外传来，紧接着一道身影直接推门而入，连通报都省了。
杨卤睁开眼，看着面前这个风风火火的女子，眼角抽了抽。
杨瑾依，他女儿。
四百五十岁的年纪，如今已是四星灵圣入灵境，在西南域也算是顶尖天才。但在他面前，永远都是一副小女儿姿态，完全不把他这个五星灵帝放在眼里。
“爹，你又在装死？”杨瑾依走到他面前，叉着腰，居高临下地看着他，“我在山下喊了三声你都不回，是不是又在想我娘？”
杨卤嘴角一抽：“我好歹是个五星灵帝，你能不能给我留点面子？”
“面子？”杨瑾依翻了个白眼，“你都在山上待了三百年了，连个客人都不见，要面子给谁看？给我看的我早就看腻了，给鬼看的我娘也不吃这套。”
这丫头，嘴真毒。
“说吧，又来找我干什么？”杨卤叹了口气，他知道这闺女无事不登三宝殿，每次来找他准没好事。
杨瑾依嘿嘿一笑，凑到他面前，搓了搓手指：“爹，你那个碧波玄玉鼎，借我用用呗？”
“碧波玄玉鼎？”杨卤眉头一皱，“那可是四星灵器，你要它做什么？”
“我夫君那边最近和隔壁宗门有点摩擦，想借点宝贝镇镇场子。”杨瑾依理所当然地说道，“你那么多宝贝，放也是放着，借我用用又不掉块肉。”
杨卤脸色一黑：“你上次来借的紫光雷珠呢？还了吗？”
“那个啊……”杨瑾依眼神飘忽，“那个不是掉进河里了嘛……”
“掉河里了？”杨卤瞪大眼睛，“那可是四星灵器！你跟我说掉河里了？”
“哎呀，我又不是故意的！”杨瑾依理直气壮，“再说了，你都五星灵帝大圆满了，宝贝多的是，少一件两件的也无所谓！”
杨卤气得胡子都翘了起来：“你这丫头，我是你爹不是你仓库！三百年了你就没给我省过心！”
“那你还不是我亲爹？”杨瑾依直接怼了回去，“我娘活着的时候你就宠我，我娘走了你更应该宠我！不然我娘在天之灵得多伤心啊！”
一提到徐云，杨卤的气势就弱了几分。
徐云是他这辈子唯一的遗憾。
当年他带着全家一起穿越到这个修星世界，靠着过人的天赋和拼命的劲头，一路走到五星灵帝大圆满，成为西南域霸主。但徐云天生没有灵根，无法修炼，只能做个凡人。
凡人寿命不过百年。
徐云走的那天，杨卤抱着她冰冷的身体，哭得像个孩子。
后来女儿出嫁，他就彻底封闭了灵黔峰，再也不问世事。
一晃就是三百年。
“爹？”杨瑾依见他不说话，伸手在他面前晃了晃，“你别又沉浸在回忆里啊，我跟你说正事呢！碧波玄玉鼎借不借？”
杨卤回过神来，看着这个被他宠坏的女儿，无奈地叹了口气：“借，借！你自己去库房拿吧，别给我弄坏了就行。”
content_en:
Lingqian Peak, the main peak hall.
Yang Lu sat cross-legged on the futon, his eyes slightly closed, and the five golden star cores around him slowly rotating, exuding a faint imperial power.
Three hundred years.
Since the death of his wife Xu Yun, he has been staying at home on this mountain peak, not even seeing his old friends who once fought side by side. After his daughter got married, he was the only lonely old man left guarding this huge Lingqian Peak.
It's not right to call him an old man. The lifespan of a star cultivator is long. His face looks like he is in his early eighties or nineties, but his heart is already very old.
"Dad!"
A clear shout came from outside the hall, and then a figure pushed the door directly in, even without announcing.
Yang Lu opened his eyes and looked at the hot-tempered woman in front of him, his eyes twitching.
Yang Jinyi, his daughter.
At the age of four hundred and fifty, he is now a four-star spiritual saint who has entered the spiritual realm, and is considered a top genius in the Southwest Region. But in front of him, she always acted like a little daughter, completely ignoring him as the five-star spiritual emperor.
"Dad, are you pretending to be dead again?" Yang Jinyi walked up to him, put her hands on her hips, and looked at him condescendingly, "I called you three times at the bottom of the mountain and you didn't reply. Are you thinking about my mother again?"
The corner of Yang Lu's mouth twitched: "I am a five-star spiritual emperor after all, can you save some face for me?"
"Face?" Yang Jinyi rolled her eyes, "You have been in the mountain for three hundred years and you haven't even seen a single guest. Who do you want to show face to? I've long been tired of seeing it to me, and my mother won't accept it if you show it to ghosts."
Yang Lu: "..."
This girl has such a vicious mouth.
"Tell me, why are you coming to me again?" Yang Lu sighed. He knew that this girl would not go to the Three Treasures Hall for any reason, so every time she came to see him, she would be up to no good.
Yang Jinyi chuckled, came up to him, and rubbed her fingers: "Dad, can you lend me your blue-wave black jade cauldron?"
"Bi Bo Xuan Jade Cauldron?" Yang Lu frowned, "That is a four-star spiritual weapon. What do you want it for?"
"My husband's side has been having some friction with the sect next door recently, and he wants to borrow some treasures to keep things afloat." Yang Jinyi said matter-of-factly, "You have so many treasures, it's okay to put them away. You can lend them to me without losing a piece of meat."
Yang Lu's face darkened: "Where are the purple thunder beads you borrowed last time? Have you returned them?"
"That..." Yang Jinyi's eyes wandered, "Didn't that one fall into the river..."
"Falled into the river?" Yang Lu's eyes widened, "That's a four-star spiritual weapon! Did you tell me that it fell into the river?"
"Oh, I didn't mean it!" Yang Jinyi said confidently, "Besides, you have reached the Great Consummation of the Five-Star Spiritual Emperor. There are plenty of treasures, so it doesn't matter if you are missing one or two!"
Yang Lu was so angry that his beard stood up: "You girl, I am your father, not your warehouse! You haven't given me any trouble in three hundred years!"
"Then you are not my biological father?" Yang Jinyi responded directly, "You pampered me when my mother was alive, and you should pamper me even more when my mother is gone! Otherwise, my mother's spirit in heaven will be so sad!"
As soon as Xu Yun was mentioned, Yang Lu's momentum weakened a bit.
Xu Yun is the only regret in his life.
Back then, he took his whole family to travel to this world of star cultivation. Relying on his extraordinary talent and hard work, he made it all the way to the Great Consummation of the Five-Star Spiritual Emperor and became the overlord of the Southwest Territory. But Xu Yun was born without spiritual roots and could not cultivate, so he could only be a mortal.
Mortal life span is no more than a hundred years.
The day Xu Yun left, Yang Lu hugged her cold body and cried like a child.
Later, when his daughter got married, he completely closed Lingqian Peak and never participated in world affairs again.
Three hundred years passed in a blink of an eye.
"Dad?" Seeing that he didn't speak, Yang Jinyi stretched out her hand and waved it in front of him, "Don't be immersed in memories again, I want to talk to you about business! Do you want to borrow the Bibo Xuan Jade Cauldron?"
Yang Lu came back to his senses, looked at his spoiled daughter, and sighed helplessly: "Borrow it, borrow it! Go to the warehouse and get it yourself, just don't break it for me."
